content.description: Daemon Sprites is comprised of two things. NFTs and AI. A Daemon is a computer program that runs as a background process. A Sprite is a two-dimensional image, most often in a 2D video game. AI Access. Enjoy access to AI chat with your NFT as your key. Blockchain Only. Conversations are not stored or retained by us. The only data we use and provide will be on the ledger. Global Inclusion. Our NFTs allow you to choose your language. AI and Blockchain capabilities are only just beginning.
